full_prompt_en: A dense, vintage adventure-comic painting shows two weathered explorers threading through a rocky underworld crowded with bones, skulls, and strange pale growths. A white-haired, white-bearded man in a rust-red coat dominates the center, turned to the right as he pushes past a mound of cream-colored fragments. A second, smaller traveler in an ochre hood follows at the left, partly hidden by packs and rough terrain. The background is almost entirely filled with tangled shapes: dark cave openings, reddish roots, small rounded stones, fossil-like shells, and broken bone forms. One nearly black pocket at the upper left gives the eye a moment of depth among the packed detail. Fine dark ink contours and crosshatching draw the men's weathered features, garment folds, and countless little surface edges. Muted watercolor or gouache-like color settles over the lines in burnt sienna, ochre, olive brown, warm gray, and chalky ivory. The white beard and pale clustered fragments create bright accents within a generally earthy, low-key palette. Light is subdued and diffuse, catching irregular high points rather than forming a clear beam; recesses are deepened with dark brown layered strokes. The frame is tightly cropped on all sides, so the setting seems to continue beyond the page. Diagonal movement runs from the hooded follower through the central red shoulder into the pale mound at right. Despite its near-overwhelming texture, the enlarged face and red coat keep the action legible, giving the scene a curious, uneasy, handmade storybook force.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅密集的复古冒险漫画画面呈现两位饱经风霜的探险者穿过被骨骼、头骨和奇异浅色生长物挤满的岩石地下世界。白发白胡子、穿锈红外套的男子占据中央，转向右侧，正在越过奶油色碎块堆。第二位较小旅人戴赭色兜帽，跟在左侧，部分被行囊与粗糙地形遮住。背景几乎全由纠结形状填满：暗洞、红褐色根须、小圆石、化石样贝壳和断裂骨形。左上一个近乎全黑的洞穴口让目光在堆积细节中获得片刻纵深。细暗墨轮廓与交叉排线描出两人的风化面貌、衣褶和无数细小表面边缘。低饱和水彩或水粉般颜色覆盖在线条上，形成焦赭、黄褐、橄榄棕、暖灰和粉笔象牙白。白胡须与成簇浅色碎片成为总体土色、低明度调色中的亮点。光低调且漫射，只抓到不规则高处，没有清楚光束；凹陷由深棕叠笔加重。四边裁切紧密，使环境仿佛延续到纸外。斜向运动从兜帽跟随者穿过中央红肩，进入右边浅色堆。尽管纹理几乎压倒一切，放大的面孔与红外套仍保持动作易读，使场景有好奇、不安又手工绘本式的力量。
style_prompt_en: Vintage adventure-comic illustration packs fine ink contour, crosshatching, and layered earthy washes into a densely textured frame. Burnt sienna, ochre, olive brown, and warm gray occupy most of the surface, with chalky ivory clusters and a concentrated rust-red accent providing clarity. Small organic loops, chips, roots, speckles, and broken edges overlap almost everywhere; a few dark open pockets give them spatial depth. The central readable mass is larger and warmer than the surrounding miniature textures, letting the eye find a route through the visual abundance. Light is subdued and diffuse, catching raised irregular surfaces rather than making a strong directional highlight. Dark brown strokes gather in hollows, while pale grain and uneven pigment keep the underlying paper present. Cropping is close on all sides, implying the dense world extends beyond the frame. A diagonal chain of accent shapes carries movement across the clutter. The result is tactile, intricate, slightly uneasy, and full of handmade narrative energy.
style_prompt_zh: 复古冒险漫画插画把细墨轮廓、交叉排线和层叠土色罩染填入密纹画框。焦赭、黄褐、橄榄棕和暖灰占据大半表面，成簇粉笔象牙白与集中锈红强调带来清晰度。小小有机回环、碎屑、根状笔痕、斑点与破裂边缘几乎处处叠压；少数暗色开放口袋带来空间深度。中央易读体块比周围微型纹理更大、更暖，让目光在丰富视觉中找到路线。光低调而漫射，只抓住凸起不规则表面，而不制造强方向高光。深棕笔聚于凹陷，浅颗粒与不均颜料保留底纸存在。四边紧裁，暗示密集世界还延续在画框之外。一条斜向强调色形链带着运动穿过杂密表面。结果可触、繁复、略令人不安，并充满手工叙事能量。
theme_en: Two weathered explorers threading through a crowded underworld of bones and rock
theme_zh: 两名饱经风霜的探险者穿过骨石堆积的地下世界
name: Marie Severin
